name: Algorithm 23 Code
definition: Cryptographic algorithms for encryptions with a symmetric cryptographic key.

EA2C.name: AES 128 CBC
EA2C.definition: AES (Advanced Encryption Standard) CBC (Chaining Block Cypher) encryption with a 128 bits cryptographic key as defined by the Federal Information Processing Standards (FIPS 197 - November 6, 2001 - Advanced Encryption Standard).

E3DC.name: DES 112 CBC
E3DC.definition: Triple DES (Data Encryption Standard) CBC (Chaining Block Cypher) encryption with double length key (112 Bit) as defined in FIPS PUB 46-3 - (ASN.1 Object Identifier: des-ede3-cbc).

EA9C.name: AES 192 CBC
EA9C.definition: AES (Advanced Encryption Standard) CBC (Chaining Block Cypher) encryption with a 192 bits cryptographic key as defined by the Federal Information Processing Standards (FIPS 197 – November 6, 2001 - Advanced Encryption Standard).

EA2R.name: AES 128 CTR
